§a[Tier 12 UMV] Red Sun General's Grace Components Factory§r
The Supreme Leader! Advances south!
A vast high-tech structure allegedly imported from a mysterious northern country on a certain peninsula.
Consumes Grace to operate: 1 t per unit. The recipe-output multiplier can be adjusted in the configuration (default 1.5, rounded).
Place a bee swarm in the controller to accelerate operation (speed bonus = floor(log2(number of bees))).
